decisions.reason: As a multi-item dietary supplement range closely aligned with the firm's consumer-health portfolio expansion, the sunk development and launch effort and earlier visible commitment make management inclined to continue it despite limited later visibility.

This standalone skin-and-hair supplement fits the firm's broadening strategy and was publicly promoted at launch, so prior commitment and the ease of attributing any weak uptake to temporary market factors favor keeping it.

Although this OTC migraine product is more distant from the firm's established offer, the dedicated launch page and likely regulatory and commercial investment create enough commitment that management would still tend to retain it for now.
